description: A spatiotemporal dataset of multi-hazard early warnings in China is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Haiyan Liu et al. Effective disaster risk reduction depends on hazard detection and on the timely dissemination of administrative early warnings. However, datasets that systematically document how warnings are issued across administrative hierarchies remain limited. Coverage: national (CN); published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The paper's page was read, but no repository address could be taken from its machine-readable metadata, so the record links to the article, whose Data Records section names where the data sit. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
